top_strength: Dustin turned a scheduling obstacle into a close. When Greg raised the POD delivery-window problem, Dustin didn't push — he solved it and made the customer money: "I think that actually might be cost effective for you. Let me save this real quick and push it a day so that hourly rate does drop on Sundays." Greg's response — "what's more reasonable for sure" — and the booking followed directly from that move. He also opened cleanly and on script ("Our pricing is super simple"), and his quote math was clean at $206/hr against a 2.5-hour minimum.
coaching_note: The whole differentiator block went missing — No Worries, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, no hidden fees, and what's included all went unsaid, which is why a call he closed still scores 10/20 on pricing. The fastest fix is the one that also protects the estimate: he never asked what floor unit 922 is on or whether there are stairs, then quoted a flat "in and out within that two and a half hour minimum." Ask the floor and access questions before the number, then run the differentiators as a block — this was a 6.8-minute call with room for both.
phone_presence_notes: Consistently warm and responsive ("Absolutely," "No, no, no worries"), and he acknowledged the customer's POD dilemma instead of plowing past it — held back from a 5 only by near-zero name use and no explicit empathy statements.
